reviews.checked_passages: PDF pp.2,16–19,21–38,47–48: finite relational signatures, quantifier rank, tuple positions, finite games and the fundamental theorem. PDF pp.50–74: finite-order gap strategies and the distance-two graph interpretation, including the visual gap diagrams.
reviews.outcome: No serious defect found in the adopted scope. The corpus states rank at most k, includes repeated choices, empty positions and nullary relations, and supplies the finite characteristic-family induction that the source theorem sketches. Carrier nonemptiness is explicit. The finite-order induction handles every gap case; the graph construction is restricted to n≥3 to keep its edge relation irreflexive, and the formula translation proves both truth preservation and its rank bound.
